name: 数量を増減する条件行
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH01-0078 数量を増減する条件行. Input1 original controls exact quantity-row structure and disabled-minus/current-Any/enabled-plus state. Input2 native mock supplies Japanese text/Regular font scale.
A single compact horizontal row on purewhite#FFFFFF: left label "寝室"; right aligned stepper group of white circular MINUS button, value "指定なし", white circular PLUS button. All text Meiryo REGULAR40014/24-equivalent, tracking0, dark#1D1D1D; no bold. Match original/native spacious separation between left label/right group and compact even gaps inside group. Circular buttons equal diameters, subtle neutral outlines, exact thin centered minus/plus glyph geometry; plus two perpendicular equal strokes.
Minus is disabled: pale neutral outline and palegray minus stroke. Plus is available: fine neutral outline, slate#526173 plus. Value neutral "指定なし", not zero or a number. Preserve source minimum/unrestricted visible state. Vertically center all label/value/glyphs.
No colored fill, gradient, green selection, title, background card, shadow, second row, extra icons/values. Small white margins around flat high-resolution wide component. Increment/decrement/keyboard/limits behavior unverified; raster candidate only.
reviewNotes: Japanese bedroom/unrestricted state and row alignment retained. Minus/plus glyph strokes too heavy and rounded compared with original thin flat-ended controls; disabled minus outline not differentiated enough. Needs utility glyph optical-weight correction; raster only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
